text: Idrinth Thalui - The High Elven Vampire Loremaster

The Tale of a Fallen Loremaster\\n\\nOnce a respected High Elven Loremaster, Idrinth Thalui met his mortal end during the bloody Vampire Wars, only to rise again as one of the very creatures he fought against. Now this Knight-Scholar walks a precarious path between his elven heritage and vampiric curse, seeking purpose in a world torn by Chaos.\\n\\nWill you guide him toward redemption or embrace the darkness within? His fate rests in your hands.
Allows Idrinth to spawn for Bretonnia, Cathay, the Legions of Nagash, Dark Elves and Vampire Coast as well.
Modifies the level requirement to get Idrinth's unlock quest.
Modifies the requirements for receiving the god blessed items.
Modifies the chance of Thaluian Chapels being spawned by Idrinth's presence.
Allows Idrinth to notify the player when reaching specific regions important to him.
Allows Idrinth to found chapels that strengthen the defences of cities and affect god favor generation.
Modifies the cooldown between dilemmas that require decisions.
When checked units gain a custom name on recruitment pulled from a list of elven names.
When checked this mod logs to the game root directory into idrinth.*.log.
When checked this mod logs with the base game logging function.
Modifies the cooldown between divine interventions.
When checked Idrinth is followed by a WAAAGH-army made up of animals. Disabling does not despawn the army.
Changes the chance of priests surviving being turned into vampires.
Changes the chance of story decision dilemmas triggering.
Changes the chance of god items being offered.
Enables the traits for slaying elves. Disabling does not remove existing trait levels.
Enables the traits for spending time devoted to a specific god. Disabling does not remove existing trait levels.
If enabled Asuryan, Kurnous and Khaine will intervene when your favour is high, using some of it for faction wide buffs.
When checked this mod logs with the logging provided by the MCT.
